notes.title: New Scary Humans
notes.notes:
🚀 BIG NEWS, GAMERS! 🚀

Hey there, champs! We've been grinding hard, listening to every piece of feedback you threw our way. Guess what? We basically rebuilt the entire game just for you! Presenting the revamped and supercharged version you've all been waiting for! 🎮💥

🔥 WHAT'S NEW? 🔥

🚀 Upgraded Game Engine - Smoother, faster, and spookier! Expect more FPS and even scarier humans lurking around.
🧠 Memory Boost - Rooms and foes will now remember you! No more "Who dis?" when you switch rooms.
🌌 Seamless Room Scrolling - Dive deeper into the game with our immersive room transitions.
🗺️ Efficient Map System - Navigate like a pro with our user-friendly guide-on-the-go.
🎉 Bigger & Badder - More challenges, more enemies, and simply... more of EVERYTHING! Think you can handle it?
🏆 New Achievements - Ready to flex those gaming muscles? Unlock and show off your skills as you conquer the game.
Get ready to jump into this wicked ride! Keep the feedback coming and let's keep leveling up together! 🎮🔥

notes.title: Scary Humans Remastered!
notes.notes:
[b]We have carefully listened to all your suggestions and have worked on them[/b]. After months of hard work, [b]Scary Humans is now available for you in its 2.0 version![/b] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/31cf493d1c20b6ea0bfe39312d3dd727a5cd46db.png[/img]

New designs on graphics and procedural, new menus, [b]3 new difficulty levels which makes it more addictive![/b] This version now includes a full gamepad support on every system, more fun, a more spectacular experience… 

We revisited the original game and [b]included a new map that will guide you through your escape to freedom thanks to a new optimized procedural algorithm that looks for all the possible exits…[/b] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/258703dc47d66ab353d88d5156e71c83f07013bf.png[/img]

But that doesn’t mean it will make it easy for you! Check our brand new game out, Scary Humans, [b]fully remastered![/b] The best part is, [b]it is only 2,99€ indefinitely![/b] What else could you ask for? Run away from humans!

notes.title: Working on Scary Humans’ next update
notes.notes:
At Gabhel Games, we are aware that [b]a game must be in constant evolution and the community’s opinions are crucial to the product’s success[/b]. That is why Scary Humans will keep evolving and improving, getting everything on point, adding players’ suggestions, including new game modes… 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/072ba50f4950fc340a6cf3f783e06cc64016ba1c.png[/img]

[b]These will all be free updates for all our players who have relied on the game.[/b] If you have any suggestions, queries or anything else to point out, please send them through either Steam’s community or to hello@scaryhumans.com. [b]Scary Humans is not our game, but your game[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/f6346458995f20441000aadea94ac9f6baaddaba.png[/img]

And don't forget to follow us on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/scaryhumans]@scaryhumans[/url].

notes.title: Scary Humans' story found in a tape!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/eee2bc9846d2727ac541e5e5808ea8c5708daf1e.png[/img]

A new mysterious cassette from the early 80s has been found among Gabhel Games’ lost archives. It seems to be a promotional video for a very old game, spotted at some basement in a MIC. After an arduous digitalization and restoring process, we have finally recovered the material, to present it to you now… 

[b]Discover the story behind Scary Humans on our new trailer and help Mrgrt get back home![/b]
